title: Nine Bars of Wire
subtitle: 笼子与鸟笼 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 笼子与鸟笼（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：笼子与鸟笼（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：cage　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my mother was sent to clean ① a cage she could not open, and she said the opening was the whole of the lesson. The ② cage, meaning the bars and not the bird, was nine wires high and was carried by whoever came last; a cage, she said, is the only thing in a shed that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cage in that shed had the same latch, and the ④ cage at the back, meaning the one the keeper kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever cleaned properly. A cage, my grandmother said, is nine parts wire and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the wire is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cage was the whole of the bird, meaning the life it held and not the bars. The ⑥ cage, meaning the life and not any of that, is the only thing in a market that everybody sells and nobody questions; a cage, he said, is either something you clean or the only word that means both bars and a life. She said the life is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ cage had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the wire. The ⑧ cage of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine bars and eleven years of cleaning; a cage, she said, is either the one at the back or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cage I remember is the one at the back, which was emptied in 1973 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ cage, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being emptied; every cage, she said, is a life that has agreed to look like bars. She said the life was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 笼子（指那些栅栏本身，与鸟相对）
C. 固定搭配：clean a cage 打扫一只笼子
D. n. 笼子（指棚屋里每一只）
E. n. 笼子（指后面那一只）
F. n. 笼子（抽象：它关着的那条命）
G. n. 那条命（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a cage she could not open
The cage, meaning the bars and not the bird
cage was the whole of the bird
the cage had become a photograph in a report
The cage of the whole thing
A cage, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: clean a cage 意为“打扫一只笼子”，1952 年母亲被派去打扫一只她打不开的笼子。
cage 意为“笼子”，指那些栅栏本身而不是鸟，高九根铁丝，由最后走的人提走。
cage 指棚屋里每一只笼子，每一只都是同样的插销。
cage 指后面那一只（饲养员留的那一只），是唯一有人认真打扫过的。
cage 意为“笼子”，抽象指它关着的那条命，父亲说 cage 就是那只鸟的全部。
cage 为抽象用法，指那条命本身，是市场上人人都卖、却没人质疑的东西。
cage 意为“笼子”，到 1968 年这只 cage 成了报告里的一张照片。
cage 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九根栅栏和十一年的打扫。
cage 意为“笼子”，我记得的是后面那一只，1973 年被清空，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
cage 为抽象总称，祖母说笼子是唯一会因为被清空而变好的东西。
